在线平台 / 系统 (Zàixiàn píngtái / Xìtǒng)

work.scenario: During a project meeting, your team discusses plans to 'develop a new online platform' for customer service. The manager emphasizes that it must be 'user-friendly' and asks about strategies for 'digital transformation' within the company's existing operations. Later, a colleague asks how to 'troubleshoot a technical issue' with the presentation software.

life.scenario: You're helping an elderly relative set up a new government 'online platform' for healthcare appointments. You assure them it's 'easy to use' and explain the importance of 'data privacy' for their personal information. When the app crashes, you casually say you'll 'fix the technical issue'.

tech.scenario: At a tech conference, you're discussing the latest trends. One speaker talks about how companies 'innovate new things' through 'digital transformation'. Another panelist highlights the critical need for 'data security' when 'developing online systems' to prevent cyber threats.
